questions.answer:

Apply the model for The Fresnel Diffraction Integral and Aperture Functions under every condition stated in the question; use SI units unless another unit is explicitly supplied.

Equation \([1]\) gives \(U_A=U_{\mathrm{in}}/2\) for the amplitude mask, so the local transmitted intensity is \(|t|^2=1/4\) of the incident value. Final result: \(t=1/2\) transmits one quarter of the local intensity, whereas \(t=e^{i\pi/2}\) transmits full local intensity with a quarter-cycle phase delay.
